text.p: Cordex Petroleum Inc said it started drilling the first of two central Argentine exploratory wells Monday.
The wells are in the Mogna block (CCyB-4), Bermejo Basin, where the company has identified an objective 8000 acre structure to test with the first well, the Lago x-1.

The well will evaluate an equivalent Triassic clastic sequence that is productive in the Cuyo basin, located 275 kilometers to the south. Clastics in the Lower Tertiary and fracture carbonates in the Ordovician are secondary objectives. Expected total depth is 1,180 meters, Cordex said.
The Lago x-2 is expected to be drilled to 800 meters to test both the Lower Tertiary and the Upper Triassic clastic sequence.
Cordex is operator and holds a 60 percent interest in the venture. Monument Exploracion Ltd holds the remaining 40 percent.
